svg.text: All sensors run on the 5 V rail and connect straight to the Uno (no level shifting).
Drawn: ResQBot team · Date: 2026-10-18 · Resistors ¼ W 5 %
SCL → A5, SDA → A4. The module has its own 3.3 V regulator
and 10 kΩ pull-ups. I²C address 0x5A, 100 kHz.
Fit a black tube, 10 mm inside × 22 mm long, over the
sensor to narrow its view to ~25°.
TRIG → A2, ECHO → A3, both 5 V: no divider needed on the Uno.
OUT → D4 (3.3 V high, read fine by the Uno).
Jumper on H (repeat trigger), time knob minimum,
sensitivity mid. Needs ~30 s to settle after power-on.
DATA → D2. R8 is already on the 3-pin module;
fit it only for a bare 4-pin DHT11.
Gives the air temperature next to the IR readings.
8.4 V full → 4.2 V · 6.8 V low → 3.4 V at A1.
C3 filters motor noise. Calibrate BATTERY_ADC_CAL.
